# GCP to AWS Migration Guide

This guide covers migrating your workloads from Google Cloud Platform to Amazon Web Services.

## Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Availability

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is available in 9 regions, making it suitable for most global deployments.
The service supports multi-region architectures for high availability.

## Migration Steps

1. Assess your current GCP workloads
2. Map GCP services to AWS equivalents
3. Deploy to target AWS regions
